reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's favourite V4 = (multistart-fit linear-ST + per-segment straight-sample yaw bias) minus a Ridge(alpha=1) residual learner on [v, |a_y|, |δ|, sign(δ̇)] with leave-one-segment-out CV, using the agent's triage.py functions; Cf/Cr refit per-platform on the canonical Ford set since the agent did not persist coefficients.
notes: Agent's REPORT declares 'Final overall RMSE = 0.01003, a 15.7% improvement vs V0' for V4 — picked V4 as favourite. Agent saved no coefficients, so V3 Cf/Cr were refit per-platform via the agent's exact multistart L-BFGS-B recipe. Refit per-platform Cf/Cr: {'FORD_F_150_LIGHTNING_MK1': (300000.0, 500000.0), 'FORD_MUSTANG_MACH_E_MK1': (200000.0, 200000.0)}. Ridge residual learner is a LOSO CV procedure by construction — each segment's prediction comes from a ridge model trained on the other 544 segments. Per-segment yaw-bias correction uses straight samples (≥50). Baseline recomputed RMSE matches canonical cache to 3.47e-18.
